title: Kirby Problem 4.129
exact_target: Can every closed positive-scalar-curvature four-manifold be assembled by zero- and one-surgeries from positive-scalar-curvature orbifold pieces with finite fundamental groups?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 3005 (KP-4.129). CC BY 4.0.

R. İnanç Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman (eds.), \emph{K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology}, Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 295, American Mathematical Society (2026), Problem 4.129, author preliminary version.
